repos.name: HiDream-O1-Image
repos.summary: HiDream-O1-Image is a model that creates images from text descriptions, edits existing images, and personalizes subjects based on provided examples. It can generate images at a high resolution of up to 2,048 × 2,048 pixels. The project also includes a reasoning agent that helps refine prompts before image generation.

repos.name: autoremesher
repos.description: Automatic quad remeshing tool
repos.summary: AutoRemesher is a tool that automatically converts complex 3D shapes, called high-polygon meshes, into simpler shapes made of four-sided polygons, known as quad-based topology. This process is called quad remeshing. It helps create cleaner digital models.

repos.name: lavish-axi
repos.description: HTML is the new markdown. Lavish is the new editor for your HTML artifacts.
repos.summary: Lavish Editor is a tool for reviewing and editing HTML files created by agents. It opens these files in a local browser, allowing users to interact with elements, edit diagrams, and send feedback back to the agent. This process aims to improve collaboration between humans and AI on HTML content by preserving interactivity.

repos.name: hiring-agent
repos.description: AI agent to evaluate and score resumes.
repos.summary: This project is an AI agent designed to evaluate and score resumes. It extracts structured data from PDF resumes, enhances it with information from GitHub profiles, and then provides a fair and explainable evaluation. The system aims to help rank a large number of applications by identifying which ones to review first.

repos.name: no-mistakes
repos.description: git push no-mistakes
repos.summary: This project acts as a local proxy for your code pushes, meaning when you want to send your code changes somewhere, you send them to this project first instead of directly to the final destination. It then runs your code through a series of checks, including using artificial intelligence to validate it. If all checks pass, it automatically forwards your code and opens a new request for your changes.

repos.name: codebase-memory-mcp
repos.description: High-performance code intelligence MCP server. Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph — average repo in milliseconds. 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens. Single static binary, zero dependencies.
repos.summary: This project is a high-performance code intelligence server that indexes codebases into a knowledge graph. It supports 158 languages and can answer queries very quickly, using significantly fewer computational resources than other methods. The software is distributed as a single, self-contained program with no external dependencies.

repos.name: mesh-llm
repos.description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.
repos.summary: This project pools computing resources like GPUs and memory from multiple machines to power AI models, specifically large language models (LLMs). It makes these combined resources available through an API that acts like one from OpenAI, allowing users to run AI agents and chat applications. The system can distribute models across different machines, even splitting large models into stages to run on multiple boxes.

repos.name: CPA-Manager-Plus
repos.description: A self-hosted CPA / CLIProxyAPI management panel and AI gateway observability dashboard for requests, usage, cost, quota, failures, and account health.
repos.summary: CPA Manager Plus is a self-hosted tool that helps manage and monitor AI gateways. It provides a dashboard to observe requests, track usage, analyze costs, manage quotas, and check the health of accounts. This system allows users to inspect why requests might be failing, understand where costs are originating, and ensure accounts and their limits are functioning correctly.

repos.name: kairos
repos.description: Official code for world model Kairos
repos.summary: Kairos is a world model designed for unified understanding, generation, and action prediction. It learns from various data sources, including general videos, human behavior, and real-robot interactions, to build persistent representations of the world. Kairos jointly predicts future visual states and executable robot actions, enabling long-horizon reasoning and generation for embodied artificial intelligence.

repos.name: Bonsai-demo
repos.description: Bonsai Demo
repos.summary: This project provides a demo for running Bonsai language models locally on various hardware. It allows users to interact with different versions of Bonsai models, including vision-language capabilities and tool calling. The project supports running these models on Mac, Linux, and Windows, with options for CPU or GPU acceleration.

repos.name: Unlimited-OCR
repos.description: Unlimited OCR Works: Welcome the Era of One-shot Long-horizon Parsing.
repos.summary: Unlimited OCR Works is a software project that performs optical character recognition (OCR), which is the process of converting images of text into machine-readable text. This project aims to handle long documents and complex layouts, enabling the parsing of extensive information from images. It can process single images, multiple images, and even PDF documents by converting their pages into images first.

repos.name: mattpocock-skills-zh-CN
repos.description: 这是 mattpocock/skills 的简体中文本地化版本。
repos.summary: This project is a simplified Chinese translation of the `mattpocock/skills` project. It aims to make the documentation and skill descriptions more accessible to Chinese-speaking developers and better integrate with Chinese language models. The project maintains the original functionality by keeping technical names and commands unchanged.

repos.name: frame
repos.description: FFmpeg GUI
repos.summary: Frame is a desktop application that provides a graphical interface for FFmpeg, a tool used for media conversion. It allows users to control various settings for video, audio, and image files, such as resolution, frame rate, and metadata. The application uses a Rust-based conversion core to generate FFmpeg commands and display progress.

repos.name: stealth-browser-mcp
repos.description: The only browser automation that bypasses anti-bot systems. AI writes network hooks, clones UIs pixel-perfect via simple chat.
repos.summary: Stealth Browser MCP is a tool that automates web browser interactions, designed to bypass anti-bot systems. It uses AI to write network hooks and can replicate user interfaces with high accuracy. This project allows for advanced web automation and data extraction by interacting with real browser instances.

repos.name: DNSHE-FreeDomains
repos.description: 🌐 DNSHE Official - Stable & Free Subdomains for Developers. Support 180-day renewal window, Anycast DNS, and REST API. (us.ci, cc.cd, de5.net, ccwu.cc)
repos.summary: DNSHE provides free domain registration and DNS (Domain Name System) resolution services for developers, students, and open-source projects. It offers tools to manage domain names and their associated records, and includes an API for automation.

repos.name: threejs-game-skills
repos.description: Agent skills for building playable, polished Three.js browser games with gameplay, AAA-style graphics, UI, QA, and optional AI-generated 3D, image, and audio assets.
repos.summary: This project provides tools for building browser games using Three.js, a JavaScript library for creating 3D graphics. It includes a director skill that manages various aspects of game development, such as gameplay, graphics, user interface, and asset generation. The project also offers optional integration with AI services for creating 3D models, images, and audio assets.
